impact_assessment.why: UI tasks still go rogue inside the bounded surface: ADR-158 bounds where edits land but no gate verifies what the UI renders, so lost controls, dropped handlers and aesthetic drift pass every green proof
impact_assessment.benefits: ui verify mechanically fails on removed controls/handlers via a baseline snapshot diff; hardcoded colors/fonts outside theme paths become findings; ui finish refuses without --reviewed human eyes; deterministic, stdlib-only, framework-agnostic
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive schema fields (commands.snapshot, commands.snapshot_timeout, style.theme_paths) change the contract digest and invalidate open tasks (none exist; verified no project commits ui.json); dependency: none, stdlib re/fnmatch only; concurrency: snapshot and lint run inside the existing task file_lock; state: task record gains baseline_snapshot and allowed_removals, written via atomic_write_json
impact_assessment.mitigation: old contracts without the new fields keep working with snapshot and lint off; AIKit sorts and dedups snapshot lines so adapter order does not matter; style lint is opt-in via declared theme_paths with file:line findings; snapshot_timeout bounds the proof run

impact_assessment.benefits: delivery readiness refuses open UI tasks on both surfaces; every finished UI task leaves an append-only history record (reviewer, final snapshot digest, strikes) in .aikit/ui_history.json
impact_assessment.risks: contract: finish gains a reviewer parameter and writes a new bookkeeping file; dependency: none, stdlib json/hashlib only; concurrency: history append happens inside finish's existing file_lock; state: corrupt history must abort finish instead of being overwritten
impact_assessment.mitigation: additive schema within ui_task bookkeeping; ui_history.json joins BOOKKEEPING_PATHS so it never dirties the tree or flips the track; unreadable history raises a named error and deletes nothing
